main.description: Ball is a male meowstic. He likes trains and Weezer. He is part of the class of 2027 at Verr University.

Lit is a victini. She likes spaghetti and post grunge music. She is the main character in It's Been Awhile, a comic about the death of her sister Flingy due to Lit's criminal activity, and all that entails. She is part of the class of 2027 at Verr University.
Pinewood is a vulpix. She likes graphic T-shirts and The Offspring. She works at her uncle's furniture store.
Oakwood is a vulpix. He likes burgers and playing acoustic guitar. He works at his family's furniture store.
Martha is a meowstic. Her favorite foods are pineapple and ice cream. She works at Astorabat Park, picking up trash and managing the wildlife.
Liam is a rabbit-dog. He likes iced coffee and pop music. He works at Rocky's Records and Guitars.
Comet is a male meowstic. He likes chocolate chip cookies and BeamNG drive. He is a lab assistant for the mad scientist Mose. He is part of the class of 2026 at Friendship University.
Arrow is a buizel. He is bisexual and likes Green Day. He is insecure about his poor swimming abilities. He is an author of travel books. He is part of the class of 2026 at Friendship University.
Sugar is an eevee. He likes turkey bologna, computers, and taking pictures. He is part of the class of 2026 at Friendship University.
Ash is a white cat. He likes lemonade and legos. He is a research subject, drag queen, and performer.
Teri is a cat dragon. He likes computers. They are very laid back, friendly, and silly. They are York's roommate! He works at an animal daycare.
York is a glaceon. She likes to hang out in pools.
Cypress is a green cat with wings. They are a very serious person. They eat pizza with a fork. They are a private investigator, running the Foreman Investigation Service.

info.name: Summer Hazel Culver
info.occupation: Business Owner and Guitarist for C.A.F.

main.description: Rocky is a pink dog. She is very friendly and energetic. He is a metalhead and a skilled guitarist. Her boyfriend is Nolan, and she sometimes calls him Oreo. She runs a music store in Arthur City, and employs Zilly and Liam.

Nolan is a gray foxwolf. He is extremely paranoid and jumpy. He is Rocky's boyfriend. He is transgender. He is also short, so he often takes pictures with Rocky while standing on a stool so he looks taller. He is a secret government agent.
Tem is a fox. She likes onion rings and mystery novels. She works on buses at Friendship City Transit's Embridge bus facility.
Noel is a sprigatito. This means he likes weed. He is Pluto's best friend, and Ryder's boyfriend. He is Ryder's housewife.
Ryder is a calico cat. He likes to jog and play softball. He is Noel's boyfriend. He is a news reporter at at N3 News in Evergreen.
Esther is a tortoiseshell cat. She likes bananas and listening to Nightwish. She owns the Nightwish shoes and the Nightwish watch. She is an electrician.
Nisha is a Shaymin. They care deeply about what other people think of them. They go to Friendship University.

info.name: Azure "Pocky Pulverize" Pullman
info.occupation: Walm Employee and Bassist for O.C.

main.description: Pocky is a blue cat. He likes root beer and listening to Megadeth. They work at a retail store in Evergreen.
Sage is a cat. He likes hoagies. He is Miki's brother. He is part of the class of 2026 at Rutgers University.
Sharyo is an LRV-cat. She was born/manufactured in Japan. She likes California rolls and candy.
Ram is a sheep. They like ugly sweaters and dirinks hot choocolate. They are a PhD student studying mathematics at some institution in Evergreen.
Autumn is a fox. She likes mushrooms and listening to Sleep Token. She lives in a studio apartment with Sandy and Lawrence. She has a keyboard. She is transgender. She is a dry cleaner.
Nowun is a feline-like demigod. He wears a cloak and wears an amulet and can shapeshift. He oversees the Alpha-Centauri planetary system.
Nanika is a tuxedo cat with wings. She is extroverted. She is the leader of the notorious Joe's Bees.
Joey is a deer. They like curly fries and puns. They are a stunt actor.

secondary.description: Flingy was a victini. Her favorite show was V and Ax. She was Lit's sister.
Carc is a meowstic. He was a student at Doubax Highschool and was a bully.
Glametal is a meowstic. He does commissions for evil villains. This includes making bioweapons and monsters. Carc Jr. is his son. He is yet another negligent father.
Florence is a pikachu. She is a cautious person. She was friends with Flingy, and went on to develop an uneasy acquaintanceship with Lit after Flingy's death.
Ree is a jirachi. She is regularly featured in CoJu's comic series, "It's Been Awhile". Ree's family has been bankrupt since at least 2023.
Miki is a cat. They like fishing, anchovies and dislikes their anchovies being stolen by Sage and Wayne. It is a serious person. They are part of the class of 2023 at Rutgers University.
Wayne is a cat. He likes to fish with Miki. He is part of the class of 2026 at Rutgers University.
Soiette is an Oshawott. He likes playing games in the basement. Her signature catchphrase is "Dang, bitch!".
Pluto is a fox. She is Bowie's sister and Noel's best friend.
Umber is a umbreon. He likes mystery novels and ran the NDHS book club. He is Mar's brother.
Mar is an espeon. He likes butterflies and Brussels sprouts. He is often grumpy due to his job insecurity. He doesn't usually eat his shirt.
Snodie is a vulpix. Attached to her hair and tail is Angel, a lost spirit. She is a witch and studied animal science at Verr University.

Steel is a sylveon. She is mischevious and very impulsive, and has many tattoos that are covered by her fur. He is the scientist who looks after Ash. They are infertile, and treats Ash like the son he could never conceive.
Garland, or Sandy, is a leafeon. She is confident and outgoing, and mischevious and devious. Her brother is Lawrence.
Lawrence is a leafeon. He is shy and nervious. This is in contrast to the clothes he wears. His sister is Garland. He likes to call her Gary and Garlic, but she doesn't like it.
Maureen is a cat. She likes white pizza and mocha mint iced coffee. She is an emergency medical technician.
Jeremiah is a human. He is an engineer who builds robots. He takes medication from a local herb store to take care of his mental illness.
Jimmy is a human. He is an engineer who builds robots. He loves animals and nature.
Raby is a block creature. She used to be a human named Rosalind. She is an engineer for the Futurists and a bus mechanic for Friendship City Transit.

info.name: Tigna Waterson Mose
info.occupation: Professor at Friendship University and Director of Mose's Lab

secondary.description: Mose is an alien from outer space. He currently serves as the director of a lab for Friendship University.
Colette is an alien from outer space. She is the general caretaker for Mose's army of cats and minions.
Lydia is a cat. She likes to come up with headcanons for her favorite Roblox game characters. She has to partially take care of her mentally ill father.
Glider is a gliscor. She likes Weezer. She is the daughter of Ospra and Eastmode, the owners of Ospra's and K-Club respectively. She will be a trucker shen she's older.

info.name: Aster Kawiestmoda
info.occupation: Bassist for CAF and Employee for K-Club

secondary.description: Aster is a bat. He is Glider's older brother. He is the bassist for CAF. He is trans.

info.name: Eclipse Faecervine
info.occupation: Vocalist for CAF and Veterinarian Technician

secondary.description: Eclipse is a jirachi-deer hybrid. She is the frontman of CAF. She is nonbinary.

info.name: Pegasus Nyukasa
info.occupation: Drummer for CAF and Garbage truck driver

secondary.description: Peggy is a vaporeon. She is the drummer for CAF. She is Mieoru's sister.
Mieoru is a vaporeon.
Trenton is a Jersey Arrow Cat. She is old and tired.
Amulet is a cat. Because of her physical condition, she is constantly in pain.
Sepitina is a white cat. She is a co-leader of SCF.
Rina is a white cat. She runs the Sharia Lair, where she tries to harness the power of the demigods of the Solar System.
Dorian is a male meowstic. He was formerly known as "Methlab" or, legally, "Baby Jutsja". He works for Friendship City Transit as an electrician.

Skyler is a glaceon. She is a streamer and a real estate agent. She used to collaborate with Paige The Pennsylvanian. She is Sugar's older sister. She goes by @hotglaceon5 on at least one social media. She usually goes by SkylerWearsUnderwear.
Lex is a meowstic. She is intersex. He works at K-Club.
Flan is a fox. He worked as a captain for pirate ships from the Succaneer Isles. He was chronically depressed and missed his family. He died by gears grinding in April 1918.
Rivers was a pink dog. He was not just man's best friend, but Cypress' best friend. Unfortunately, they killed him in September 2020.

tertiary.description: Kyle is a popplio. He lived in Texas on his family's cube corn farm until the house burned down. He has queer relatives living in northern Florida. He is friends with Umber.
Lily is a female meowstic. She has an interest mathematics. She had romantic tension with Ball and Carc and may have been a love interest for Lit. She was the popular girl in school. She is a model.
Far is a flareon-espeon hybrid. He is Mose's lab assistant.
Zilly is an alien from outer space. She works at Rocky's Records and Guitars.
Big Jodie is a cyclops. Her boyfriend was River CoAlla. She is transgender. She is a public school teacher.

River was a cinderace. He had a thing for Japanese girls, if you know what I mean. But he liked his girlfriend Big Jodie more. He was a stand-up comedian and jewlry store worker. He was killed in January 2020.

Ray is a cat. He has suicidal and self-destructive tendencies. He likes the song Razor by Foo Fighters. He is friends with Steel and someone else. He is a software developer and is possibly affiliated with Verr University.
Sprinkles is an eevee. He works at a cafe.
Kellie was a gardener jirachi. She was Ree's sister.
Six was a jirachi. He was emo. Yup. He listened to all them emo bands. He was Ree's brother.
Henry is a leafeon. He is roommates with Umber.
Vick is an umbreon. He is Avery's roommate. They are a mechanic.
Avery is a leafeon. He is Victor's roommate.
Muppin is a cat.
Crys is half of a cat and half of an unknown type of bug. She is transgender.
Merritt is a dog. He likes going to the beach. He is scared of thunder. He is friends with Venice.

Lynn is a flat headed human. He is Chip's brother. This character is a self-insert of CoMo, representing his youthful self. In adulthood, Lynn is known as Moe, and his head is a sphere instead of a bowl.
Chip is a stubby humanoid. It has two or three personalities. This character is a self-insert of CoJu, representing its youthful self.
Rocket was a human. She was charred into unrecognizable remains in 1994. She was rebuilt into Raby by Jimmy afterwards, and then joined the Futurists.

Pad was a pad. He was a re-usable pad for Aslarvanillamor, the queen of Connecticut. Once Pad stopped being absorbant, she abandoned him in favor of Tampon. He has become enemies with Tampon. In 1659, he was killed in Mount Friday by mega Raby.
Jeck is a robot. He was built by Jeremiah and Jimmy. He often gets destroyed in accidents.
Runchie is a cat. He causes many problems due to his insecurities from being unable to skip stones. This is quite embarrasing, since he was born in Stoneskippersville, Dexterchussets.
Tymmi is a shiny eevee. She had a sibling who died from an infection. They escaped from somewhere via sewer pipes. She is still in shock.
Turner is a rabbit-like creature. He is a sociopath. He was the de-facto leader of the NDHS bully group, and went on to do horrible things. He is currently serving a life sentence in prison.
Bowie is a fox. He likes rollerskating. He is Pluto's sister.
Kolumbus is a torracat. He is a devout Christian. He is dating Bowie Butter, and they rollerskate together.
Clarissa is a flareon. She likes to wear her elegant hat. This reflects her elegant, haughty personality. She is the counselor for North Doubax High School.
Carlos is a midnight lycanroc.
Rohr is a victini. He is the mechanic and scientist of the Pastors.
Ned is a humanoid with a ear cleaner shaped head. He is the leader of The Pastors.

Jon is a robot. When Ned and Jerry wanted to have a child, they tried turning one of their sperm into a living being. This resulted in Juke Jon and another sperm derived organism who was seen chasing Moh.
Jerry is a human. He is the third triplet of Jeremiah and Jimmy. His husband is Ned Spuun. He studied finance and economics in university.
Kelp is a block creature with duck features. They are a co-leader of SCF. They were born in Mount Friday. They changed their name in September 2024.
Italian Guy is an italian guy.

Mr. Lock is a human. He is a self proclaimed villain who has a major obsession with keys. He puts keys on omlettes and eats them and then chokes on them. He has a food truck van and a helicopter that's shaped like a key. His goal in life is to move to Southeast Pennsylvania.
Dave is a human. He was born in Mount Friday. He is Maureen's father. Before becoming a hitman, he was a social activist in northwestern Connecticut.
Ninja is a block creature with human ninja features. He was born in Mount Friday.
Edibar Junior is a Ralts. He has forks for arms. He is Edibar's son. He made Erozon to cope with the absence of his father.
Edibar is a human. His left arm is a fork. His SCF outfit is a mushroom. He was taken by a rival group after a battle and was never seen since. SCF is trying to get him back. His wife is a Gardevoir.
Bee is a dragonite. He has hair. He is often working out and stuck in traffic. The width of his penis roughly is the same as Sepitina's head.
Novic was a victini. Due to his deformed nature, he was orphaned by his parents as a result. He died on January 13, 2025 due to complications.

Marze is currently known to be a human. He is a professor at Micheal Spring's Chocolate University. He is known for building robots, including Jeck. He is well known by Bee Kellap. Marze isn't actually part of SCF.
Dan is a tiger. He has tentacles coming out of his head. This is because he ate a donut tainted by enemies.
Cleveland is a human. He is rough.
Bin is a poo bunny. He was formerly the pet of Terry. There is a replica of Bin made by the Futurists. He is friends with Liam and Martha.
Ezoron is a crosont monster. He was once Edibar's pet.
Gustavo is a human. He is Mose's general assistant. His last name comes from DanTDM saying "go sand go" in Crazy Craft episode 11.
Silver is an umbreon-human hybrid. His father is Piq-Al-Eni and mother is a poor umbreon. He is affiliated with Mose's Lab.
Willow is a vulpix. She is one of Oakwood's sisters.

Briar is a vulpix. She is a therapist. She is one of Oakwood's sisters.

[known as Tarr until a long time before Oct 7, 2025]
Fern is a vulpix. She is one of Oakwood's sisters. She is obsessed with the idea of being a twin, and calls herself Char to be more like Briar, and she copies everything Briar does. Briar hates this.

Plainwood is a vulpix. She is Pinewood's mother. She has a history of alcohol abuse. She is often drunk and therefore kicked out of the home, and mostly just roams the area woods. She is effectively absent.

Threetails is a vulpix. He is Pinewood's father. He is a lazy deadbeat father and often neglects Pinewood. He once asked Pinewood to get him a food truck burrito and if she didn't, he wouldn't feed her.
Anna is a meowstic. She is Martha and Murray's mother.
Ed is an espurr. He is Martha's cousin (Duncan's son). He is deaf.
Duncan is a meoswtic. He is Martha's uncle (Anna's brother).
Elena is an espurr. She is Martha's little sister. She likes to come with Martha and Liam on recreational trips. Sometimes they'd go with Liam's little brother Leon. Elena may get in trouble.
Murray is a meowstic. He is Martha's brother.
Jo is a vaporeon. He has horns. He is a chill and nice guy. He reads books and plays on his Switch. He is Liam's brother.
Timothy, or The Big T, or T, is a Jolteon. He is Liam's brother-in-law.
Anthony (also known as Tony or Cool Flareon) is a very cool Flareon. He is often found at festivals and fairs, displaying himself as a Cool Flareon. He is Liam's cousin. He is big.
Diamond is a glaceon. She is Liam and his siblings' mother.
Elle is a leafeon. She is Liam's cousin. She works at the Pulster Art Museum in Eirmandol. She is smug and has a superiority complex.
Leon is an umbreon. He is Liam's little brother.
Michelle is an espeon. She is Liam's sister.
Noelle is a sylveon. She is Liam's sister. She has no bows or ribbons.
Pearl is a sylveon. She is Liam's stepsister. She is insecure about her ribbon length.
Coco is a litten. She is dating Pearl.
LK is a deer. He is Diamond's ex-husband.
Vari is a vari. He is Diamond's current husband.
RD is a rabbit dog. He is Diamond's ex-husband.
Les was a leafeon. He was Diamond's father.
Roberta is a rabbit. She is Diamond's mother.
Emerald is a glaceon. She is Diamond's sister.
Seb is a victini. He was once the husband to Katie Cupcake. He is Lit and Flingy's biological father. He has a secret affair with Bel Cupcake.
Gus is a victini. He is Lit and Flingy's stepfather.
Katie is a victini. She is Lit and Flingy's mother.
Bel is a victini. She is Katie's sister. She has an affair with Seb.
Morgan is a male meowstic. He has a hidden illness which is expensive to treat. He is regularly away from home due to business trips.
Frankie is a female meowstic. She is Ball's mother. Born Francesca Meeneymore. [name changed night of Oct 6, 2025. also given birthday]. Friends with Amber.
Penelope is a meowstic! She is Amber's sister, and is Amber's child's biological mother. She carries around a bag of truffles.
Ardenna is a buizel. She was born sometime between 1986-1994. She is Arrow's sister.
Em is a buizel. He was once a punk rocker who got a lot of girls. He is Arrow and Ardenna's father.
Caitlyn is a dog. She is Rocky's mother. She loves England.
Melvin is Rocky's father. He runs or ran a shop in the slums of Arthur City.
Dizzy is a fox. She is Nolan's mother. [Her name was changed in late October 2025]
Juxis is a wolf. He is Democratic party politician from NY. His campaign slogan is: "I'm Juxis Cant, and I can't." He is Nolan's father. Oh, poor Nolan.
Alice is a cat. She was a notorious criminal in Radia, and she is often referred to as 'Alice The Shooter'. She is Maureen's mother.
Lenore is a cat who fell down the stairs.
Jack is a human. He is the father of Jeremiah, Jimmy, and Jerry. He has a degree in theoretical physics and the arts. This is why he married a clown.
Janet was a human. She was the mother of Jeremiah, Jimmy, and Jerry. She was Jackson's wife until she died from an overdose after being divorced. She is short.
Ham is a human. He is the vocalist of Jiva Jinotice. He is bisexual.

info.name: Laiah Zaiope
info.occupation: Guitarist and Vocalist for Jiva Jinotice

tertiary.description: Laiah is a human. She is an Australian trans woman who was born and raised in Atlantic City. She was a guitarist and vocalist for Jiva Jinotice. She moved to Seattle in 2005. She died in her apartment in December 2019. Her death is rumored to be caused by supernatural means.

info.name: Beui Antodaler
info.occupation: Keyboardist and Guitarist for Jiva Jinotice

tertiary.description: Beui is a human. She is the keyboardist and guitarist for Jiva Jinotice. She is a lesbian.
Toon is a human. They are a bassist for Jiva Jinotice. They are nonbinary.
6 Year Old Fat Kid is a human. He is asexual. He is not actually 6 years old.
Snibbles is a wumo. He is the drummer for Jiva Jinotice. They are asexual.
Gabriel is a human. He was born without a collarbone. He is a weeb. He is the de facto police commissioner for the FCPD.
Sheila is a human. She is a police officer for the FCPD. She may have the ability to turn into a spider at will.
Akira is an LRV-cat. She and Sharyo are good friends.
Rush is an LRV-cat. In line with his name, he is very fast.
Spark is an LRV-cat. She and Rush are good friends.
Berger is an LRV-cat.
Nona is a poodle dog. She's rocker with a nose ring. She likes wrestling, men, rap metal, weed, and liquor. She drives a Pontiac Firebird Trans-Am. She wears fishnets and has dreadlocks.
Iris is a cat.
Ivy is a cat. She is a guitarist.

Gardenia is a cat who is or was an undergraduate student at Princeton University. She dormed with June. June often uttered "Damn it, Cleaves!" due to how often she was bothered by Gardenia's shenanigans.
Venice is a creature. Friends with Merritt.
Tide is a cat. He is blue and carbonated. He is friends with Pea and Amulet.
Pea is an orange cat.
Forress is a fox who has an interest in journalism and investigation. He is Cypress' assistant. He went to the school counselor in Doubax Elementary and got bullied about it.

Ten Man is an entity who is known for creating the universe. He is often depicted in a humanoid form. It is known by at least one mortal on Earth that he was grounded by his mother and is stuck in his room for all eternity. He is made of Tennonite.
Beryl is a "giant sequoia that teleports on occasion".
Protector Weird is a Protector.
Cassot is a humanoid with an onion head. His energy was harvested by the life forms of Planet Coju.
Strobbot is a humanoid with a strawberry (or carrot) head. He caused a great flood on Planet Coju as punishment for them harvesting the energy of his best friend Cassot.
Linus is a demigod. He got mad at Nowun.
Chubby is a human. He loves cookies, beans, clouds, and Jupiter. He is Fishabit's brother in law. Also, his father was 16 when he was born.
Fishabit is a human. She who loves the sea. She is Chubby's sister-in-law.
Jen is a human. She is friends with Chip. She smokes.
Lenny is a human. He is a punk kid who likes skateboarding. He probably listens to hip-hop or nu metal or something.

Buince is a buizel. He enjoys photos of celestial objects which temperatures are above 5000 Celsius. He is a railfan and busfan. He has or had a pet poo bunny named Bin. His parents divorced and he lives with his uncle in Arthur City. Terry runs a bakery. More of his backstory is documented in CoJu's "Don't Call Me Terry" (2019) He eats sticks of butter as a snack.
Bax is a robot. He has a mildly successful [YouTube] channel. He lives in Barwick, Evergreen. Bax is best friends with Pam.
Pam is a protogen with rabbit features. She runs on Windows 11 and is therefore a bit slow. She lives in Barwick, Evergreen. Pam is best friends with Bax.
Mr. Seet is a human. He is a highschool dropout with blond hair. He is acquanitences with Sepitina and Mr. Lock. His favorite song is Butterfly by Crazy Town.
Aslarvanillamor is a giant. She used Pad for her Pad before Pad became a Bad Pad. She is the queen of Connecticut.
Wyllisk is a giant. He has umbrellas for eyes (he regularly sheds them). He is the king of Connecticut.

Petworth is a human. He is a Republican politician from New Jersey. He is the current president of The United States. His vice president is Fredorak Meatham. He was the frontman of a mildly successful hair metal band in the 80s.
Meatham is a human. He is a Republican politician from Utah. He is the current vice president of The United States.

Burna is a human. She is a Democratic politician. She ran for Friendship City mayor in the 2020s. She formerly explored lands with Hannah Goria with Pecan Meowth and Pecan Espeon. She was friends with Merrice, who she met in grade school. It is unknown whether she got assassinated overseas.
GPR is a human. He is the current mayor of Friendship City. He is part of the Democratic party.
Cryopia is a human. He is a secret agent for the United States. He is Nolan's mentor. He has been friends with Windowson Mac since grade school.
Windowson Mac is a human. He is a crypto bro who resides in the United States. He has been friends with Max Cryopia since grade school. He has right-leaning political and social views.

cojuverse.description: Rain is a tired Espeon journalist who lives with Paige. It teams up with Blair to reunite xem with xer siblings and put Lincoln in prison.
Blair is a shiny Espeon who is very extroverted and optimistic and generally energetic. Xe is a private investigator who suspects xer siblings are doing something they shouldn't be.
Reba is a hybrid between a Flareon and an Espeon. She is assertive. Reba stopped being shy on August 15, 2020.
Axel is a hybrid between a Flareon and an Umbreon! He hates doing anything. Unless it's for Reba. They also own a casino.
Crab is an Eevee who is friends with Nolan. Not actually cut out for the hitman thing.
MJ is a sad and homeless gun dealer who lives in Snowstorm.

Marianne is a sylveon. She's a tough, energetic leader. Marianne was a professional wrestler before getting involved in the criminal life. In fact, the destruction of her reputation was what made her turn to crime in the first place. Related to Sydney, but she doesn't know it.
Jam is a hybrid between an Espeon and a Flareon. Jam is very silly. It works at Aitana's, which is its adoptive older sister's pizza place.
October is a Glaceon. June's younger sister. She used to be born October 11, 2002.
OH MY GOD.... HERE SHE COMES... IT'S THE PENNSYLVANIAN! Paige is a Furret! She is sweet and a little quiet. Rain lives with him.
Sydney is a shiny Sylveon! He is a Russian bartender. Holds down a more stable bank telling job on the side. He is friends with Steel.
Adakite is a hybrid between a Meowstic and a Leafeon. Ne is a serious, grave demigod.
Vermillion is a hybrid between a Vulpix and a gorgon. She is a firey, loud demigod.
Saccharide is a Primarina-Azumarill hybrid. He is a manipulative, evil demigod.
Clementine is a flareon. She is a mystic scientist, and Jam and Marisol's unwilling adoptive mother.

info.name: Lexi Fairgrove
info.occupation: Mechanic, Roller Skating Instructor, and Indie Band Vocalist/Keyboardist

cojuverse.description: Lexi is a jolteon. She is an asexual lesbiano. She is very nice and cheerful!
Burnie is a flareon. He is big, fat, and pan. He is a chef. He is hyper. You'd think he drinks five cans of Red Bull every morning. Needlessly verbose.

June is a glaceon. She is a demisexual lesbian. She is a perfectionist - which makes her resent herself. Works well under pressure. Pretends to be stoic. June is studying business and medicine at the same time, because she's the prized family overachiever. She has a sister named October who her parents couldn't give half a damn about.
Lincoln is an espeon. He has some anger management issues. A charmer when he isn't screaming at you. He owns a museum, and may have killed his uncle for it.
Ion is A Skuntank! She is a drummer for OFFENSIVE CONTENT.
Ashley is an Absol! Vi is a guitarist for OFFENSIVE CONTENT
Mae is a 4'9 Fennekin. She is fun and bubbly and cheerful. Mae loves her garden, and plants in general. Apparently, she has a dog.
Amber is a Meowstic! They are dating Riley. Carves absurd things out of wood - one time, she made a whole mini-living room. One of Comet's mothers.
Riley is a Hattrem with Slurpuff elements? Apparently? What? Riley is deaf, and dating Amber. They're also fat, and tall. One of Comet's mothers. They are an alien.
Cedar is a glaceon who looks dumb.

Marisol seems happy enough running her late mother's business to an outsider, but really, she hates it more than you know. Keeping the restaurant alive ever since she was 11 with no one to help but her adopted sibling, Jam, has completely and utterly crushed her dreams of film school. But, well, it's fine! Not like she can work anywhere else without a diploma! That's just life, baby!
Kory is a fallen demigod fox who lives in cyberdystopia.

Tessa is a cat from the future! She is is really interested in crime in the early 21st century. This is because she lives in the year 2092. I MEAN 2090. Also she's chubby. Tessa is friends with Rory, Apollo, and Carter (032023).

Val is a laid-back Snowstorm native who handles a lot of the Snowstorm Mares' affairs. Having hit it off with Brooklyn when she arrived back in 2016, they became close friends and built the city's Lavender Mares division from the ground up. When they aren't tending to the Snowstorm Mares, she likes to unwind with trap music and a pack of cigarettes.
Brooklyn is a pink glaceon who runs the Snowstorm Mares.
Matilda is Riley's strange cousin. She is crazy and 5'9. She changed her name on Nov 12, 2024.
Sapphire is serious and 5'7.
Tessa's friend.
Tessa's friend.
Tessa's friend.
Athena is a stern Wooloo who likes bees and archery.
Spice is a flareon who was too hot to die. They died anyway. They were well known for being a supporting character who was often in police chases.
